samples.question: Thin gray lines split this image into four panels: top-left, top-right, bottom-left and bottom-right. Every panel contains four identical dark bars that differ only in position and direction. A bar's direction is the direction of its long axis, ignoring which end is which, so directions are compared modulo 180 degrees. In exactly one panel, two of the four bars have the same direction and are therefore exactly parallel. Every other pair of bars in the same panel differs in direction by at least 3 degrees. Bar colour, bar size, bar count and panel position carry no information about the answer. Which vertical half of the image contains the exactly parallel pair? Answer with exactly one of: left, right.
